convert_blt_weights_to_transformers: convert BLT model weights to HuggingFace transformers format by running the convert_to_transformers CLI command
load_blt_model_from_hub: load a BLT model and tokenizer from the HuggingFace hub using the load_transformers CLI command with source hub
load_blt_model_locally: load a BLT model, entropy model, and tokenizer from local directories using the load_transformers CLI command with source local
generate_text_with_blt: generate text completions from a prompt using a loaded BLT model with realtime patching enabled via the load_transformers CLI
load_tokenizer_and_patcher: load a BltTokenizerAndPatcher from a HuggingFace repo or local directory using from_pretrained to get tokenizer and patcher args
